info.title: Symplast Documents Public API
info.description: Authenticated public surface for patient documents: upload to a patient's chart, a change feed of document metadata, short-lived content links, and the practice's document types.

post.summary: Upload a document to a patient's chart
post.description:
**Required scope:** `documents.files.write`

Uploads one document (`multipart/form-data`, at most 100 MiB) for a patient the signed-in user can access,
filed under an uploadable document type (see `GET /v1/documents/document-types`), an active provider and,
optionally, an active location. The document is stored exactly as a document uploaded in Symplast and is
attributed to the signed-in user. When `sharedWithPatient` is true, the patient receives the usual
notification.

There is no idempotency key: a retried upload creates a second document. `sha256` is an integrity check only.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `documents.files.read`

Returns a cursor-paged feed of the documents the signed-in user may access. Ordered by `updatedAt` ascending,
then `id` ascending. Resume with `updatedSince` or follow `next`. `updatedAt` is the latest change to the
document, to its consent form's status, or to whether it is shared with the patient. Filter with
`updatedSince` (UTC, inclusive), `patientId` and `documentTypeId`. Pending consent forms are never returned.

With `updatedSince`, deleted documents are included with `isDeleted: true`, so a consumer observes deletions;
without it, only active documents are returned. Documents removed permanently (rare, internal only) do not
appear.

Delivery is at-least-once across passes: dedupe on `id` keeping the highest `updatedAt`, and resume at
`updatedSince = lastSeenUpdatedAt - 1 hour` (the overlap absorbs daylight-saving changes on the server).

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only documents changed at or after this instant (inclusive), as an ISO-8601 date-time; a value with no offset is UTC. To resume a sync, pass the largest `updatedAt` you have already received (less one hour; see the operation description), or follow `next`. With it, deleted documents are included with `isDeleted: true`. Omit it to start from the beginning of the feed (active documents only).

parameters.name: patientId
parameters.description: Only documents in this patient's chart. Omit it for every patient the signed-in user may access.

parameters.name: documentTypeId
parameters.description: Only documents of this type: an `id` from `GET /v1/documents/document-types`. Omit it for every type.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `documents.files.read`

Returns one active document that the signed-in user may access.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `documents.files.read`

Returns a presigned URL for the document's original content, with the time it expires. Download it without
an `Authorization` header. Request a new link rather than caching one.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `documents.files.read`

Returns a cursor-paged list of the practice's active document types. Ordered by `id` ascending. Every type a
document can carry is listed; `uploadable` is false for types that do not accept uploads (consent forms, read-only system
folders, and types the app generates itself).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, taken from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Pass it back unchanged; omit it for the first page. The `next` link already carries it.

403.description: The caller is not allowed to do this. A token without the required scope gets an RFC 9457 problem with code `insufficient_scope`.

IFormFile.description: The binary content of an uploaded file, sent as a part of a multipart/form-data request body.

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicDocument.description: One page of `PublicDocument` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

data.description: The items in this page, in feed order. Empty when there are none.

pageSize.description: The page size used for this page: the requested `pageSize`, or the default.

count.description: The number of items in `data`; never more than `pageSize`.

hasMore.description: Whether another page follows. Keep paging while this is true.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, to pass as `cursor`. Null when `hasMore` is false.

next.description: Relative URL of the next page, ready to request. Null when `hasMore` is false.

PagedResponsePublicDocumentType.description: One page of `PublicDocumentType` items. Keep following `next` (or pass `nextCursor` as `cursor`) while `hasMore` is true.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: URI reference identifying this occurrence of the problem.

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details describing an error response.

id.description: The document id, unique within the tenant.

fileName.description:
The file name: the renamed name when the document was renamed (for example by a folder move), otherwise the
uploaded name. May be empty for legacy documents that never had one.

extension.description: The stored file extension, lowercase, without a dot.

patientId.description: The patient the document belongs to.

documentTypeId.description:
The document type (see `GET /document-types`), or `null` when the document's stored type matches no active
document type (for example a folder deleted outside documents-api).

documentTypeName.description: The document type's display name, or the stored type name when no active type matches.

providerId.description: The provider the document is filed under.

locationId.description: The location the document is filed under, or 0 when none.

sharedWithPatient.description: Whether the document is shared with the patient.

isDeleted.description: Whether the document is deleted. Deleted documents appear only in feeds requested with `updatedSince`.

uploadedAt.description: When the document was uploaded (UTC), or `null` for legacy documents.

uploadedByUserId.description: The Symplast user who uploaded the document, or `null` for legacy documents.

createdAt.description: When the document record was created (UTC).

updatedAt.description:
The change-feed watermark (UTC): the latest change to the document, its consent record, or its sharing with the
patient.

PublicDocument.description: A document in a patient's chart. All timestamps are UTC (ISO-8601).

url.description: The presigned URL. Never log or cache it.

PublicDocumentLink.description:
A short-lived download link for a document's original content. Download it without an `Authorization` header:
the URL is presigned, and storage rejects a request carrying both.

id.description: The type id, as used by `documentTypeId`.

displayName.description: The display name, or `null` when the type has none (show `name` instead).

uploadable.description:
Whether documents may be uploaded under this type. Consent forms, read-only system folders and system-generated
types are listed (their documents appear in the feed) but are not uploadable.

PublicDocumentType.description: A document type (a folder in the patient's chart).

oneOf.description: The file part (required). Its file name must have an extension. At most 100 MiB.

patientId.description: The patient the document belongs to (required). The signed-in user must be able to access the patient.

documentTypeId.description: The document type (required): an id from `GET /document-types` with `uploadable: true`.

providerId.description: The provider to file the document under (required): an active provider in the practice.

locationId.description: The location to file the document under: an active location in the practice. Defaults to none (0).

sharedWithPatient.description: Whether to share the document with the patient. Defaults to `false`.

sha256.description: The content's SHA-256 (hex). When given, a mismatch rejects the upload with `422 hash-mismatch`.

PublicDocumentUploadRequest.description: A `multipart/form-data` upload of one document to a patient's chart.

Bearer.description: Bearer access token. Send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Documents in patients' charts, such as forms, letters and consents. Sync them from the change feed, download the content through a short-lived link, or upload a new document to a chart.

tags.name: Document Types
tags.description: The kinds of document the practice uses. Every document has one, and `uploadable` says which ones accept uploads.
